content.name: Sophie Lavoie
content.title: Senior Customer Service Representative (Bilingual)
content.summary: Bilingual (French/English) customer service representative with eight years in telecom, home insurance and energy. Serves customers in both official languages, mentors new hires and helped reduce billing complaints by 22% by rewriting confusing bill explanations.

experience.title: Bilingual Customer Service Agent
bullets: Handled about 65 calls a day in French and English on billing, plan changes and service outages.
Met or beat retention targets in 9 of 10 quarters by matching customers with a better-fitting plan rather than offering discounts.
Translated and corrected French versions of 35 knowledge-base articles that agents had flagged as unclear.

experience.title: Customer Service Representative
bullets: Answered policyholder questions on coverage, payments and renewals, and processed simple endorsements on the spot.
Moved to remote work during the pandemic and kept a 4.6 out of 5 satisfaction rating through the transition.
Trained six new bilingual hires on the policy admin system and call flow during their first month.
Caught a recurring renewal letter error affecting about 1,800 policies and escalated it before mailing.

experience.title: Senior Customer Service Representative (Bilingual)
bullets: Resolve escalated billing, meter and payment arrangement cases for residential members in Ontario and western Québec.
Rewrote the explanations on the bill insert in plain French and English, which helped cut billing complaints by 22% over a year.
Mentor four junior representatives and run the weekly huddle on new policies and tricky calls.
Track contact reasons in Excel each month and share the top five with the billing team, leading to two system fixes.

achievements.title: Bilingual service award
achievements.detail: Recognized by Bytown Home Insurance for top bilingual quality scores in 2022.

achievements.title: Plain language project
achievements.detail: Led the bill-insert rewrite with marketing and billing; adopted across the co-op.
